# Tally

> A local list, task and dependency manager that AI agents use through MCP tools. Persistent between sessions, no UI, no account, data stays on the user's machine.

If you are an agent that was pointed at this site, read the full usage guide first:

- [Agent guide](https://msiebert.github.io/Tally/agents.md): how to install, connect and use Tally's tools
- [Source and README](https://github.com/msiebert/Tally): code and technical details
- [Product page](https://msiebert.github.io/Tally/): overview for humans
